products.text:
Type: small medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area or entry, softening floors; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, bohemian, classic
Materials: low flat woven pile, printed pattern
Colors: warm brick red, steel blue, cream, dark navy accents
Shape: rectangular, all-over repeating floral medallion lattice, wide blue patterned border, thin flat profile, compact
Feel: warm, rich, inviting, timeless
Goes with: light or rustic wood, white walls, brick or stone floors; traditional, farmhouse or eclectic rooms

Type: handcrafted geometric wool rug
Use: defining a seating or reading area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: wool and cotton, flat textured weave
Colors: dark taupe brown, cream
Shape: rectangular, bold zigzag chevron bands of fine stripes with dotted rows, flat low profile, medium size
Feel: graphic, earthy, warm, structured
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets, white walls; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: traditional floral area rug

Colors: cool light grey, cream, charcoal accents
Shape: rectangular, all-over scattered Persian floral motifs, wide cream ornamental border, thin profile, medium size
Feel: calm, elegant, soft, understated
Goes with: dark wood floors, charcoal or grey sofas, white walls; traditional, transitional or farmhouse rooms

Type: speckled wool area rug

Goes with: wood floors, charcoal or grey sofas, white walls; minimalist, Scandinavian or Japandi rooms

Colors: deep red, pink, cream, green, navy accents

Type: medallion runner rug
